title: TaskDTO
description: Stable read-surface wire shape mesh emits to console-ui for a single orchestrated task. DISTINCT from mesh's internal Task DB-row struct. Ledger fix: the raw routing_json/execution_json/result_json blob STRINGS are NOT passed through — toDTO() parses each blob into a named, optional, NARROW sub-object (routing/execution/result). additionalProperties:false makes a smuggled column or a raw blob string a structural validation failure. The TypeScript interface in src/read-surface-task.ts is the paired source of truth.

project_key.description: Authority-resolved project slug. OPEN string — resolved data-driven, not a roster union.

routing.description: Parsed projection of routing_json. Raw blob string NOT passed through.

execution.description: Parsed projection of execution_json. Raw blob string NOT passed through.

result.description: Parsed projection of result_json. Raw blob string NOT passed through.
